findings: Natural-gas plant liquids are transferred to petroleum supply; NGPL must not be treated as total natural gas.
Storage stocks and injections/withdrawals are distinct measures.
Industrial use includes lease/plant fuel and other industrial deliveries; transportation includes pipeline/distribution and vehicle use. Individual components are not whole-sector totals.
Bilateral import/export country labels are U.S. trade partners, not the subject country.

findings: Table distinguishes small-scale and utility-scale generation and publishes their combined total.
Small-scale estimates cover grid-connected photovoltaic generation.
Geographic scope is the 50 states and District of Columbia.
Nonnumeric legend: NA means Not available; dash means No data reported.
Net generation is distinct from operable-unit count and capacity factor.
Capacity is the net summer capacity of operable units.
Geographic scope is the 50 states and District of Columbia.
Nonnumeric (s) in the percentage column means less than 0.05%; percentage columns are outside the authorized activities. Never convert a source symbol to numeric zero.
